description: This Java source file implements a MongoDB-backed persistence layer for the 'Things Search Updater' component in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It provides methods to retrieve policy reference tags, outdated thing IDs based on policy revisions, and to purge data related to a specific namespace. The class interacts with MongoDB collections using reactive streams and constructs BSON filters and update operations.

classes.name: MongoThingsSearchUpdaterPersistence
classes.description: A class that provides MongoDB-specific implementation of the ThingsSearchUpdaterPersistence interface. It offers methods to query and manipulate search-related data within a MongoDB collection reactively.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the persistence class with a specified MongoDatabase.

methods.name: getPolicyReferenceTags
methods.description: Retrieves policy reference tags for given policy revisions from MongoDB and returns them as a reactive Akka Source.

methods.name: getOutdatedThingIds
methods.description: Fetches IDs of things that are outdated according to a particular policy revision, returning a reactive Source of ThingId.

methods.name: purge
methods.description: Marks documents in the collection as deleted for a given namespace by setting a delete timestamp, returning a reactive stream of any exceptions encountered.

methods.name: thingNamespaceFilter
methods.description: Helper method that creates a BSON filter for documents belonging to a specific namespace.
